svg.title: Noaidi Synth prototype: veroboard wiring
svg.text: Component side. The ESP32-S3 module sits on a jumper cable plugged into the socket made for an ESP32-C3 Super Mini.

g.text: 10 kΩ slide potentiometer, wiper on GPIO1 of the socket
red LED into the lab's optical input
jumper wire, in the cable's own colour
wiring on the veroboard, coloured by signal
joint (wires that only cross are not joined)
Tang Nano numbers are FPGA package pins. ESP32 numbers are GPIOs, as printed on the boards.
Each MIDI input is the 6N138 circuit of docs/thirdparty/MIDI-circuit-6N138.png, built without its diode and fed from the ESP32's 3.3 V.
The slide potentiometer was used during early testing and was later abandoned: the jumper cable has no wire for its wiper.
